sources.note: Town of Randolph, Budget Committee page (live; read via browser -- the site serves an interstitial to direct fetches): the page lists all five members verbatim -- Christine Settles (term to 2029), Scott Frew (2028), Tamara Morgan (2027), Ken Hafner (Chair, 2027), and Scott Berkey (2027) -- and states members are elected annually at Town Meeting (vacancies by selectboard appointment).

Town of Randolph, Listers page (live; browser read): the Staff section names Dennis Brown (Chair, term to 2028) and Mimi Burstein (2027, already recorded); corroborated by the listers' minutes of July 30, 2026. The third (2026) lister seat stays open -- the page names only Brown and Burstein.
